pr_title: HTTP/3: Avoid per-request cancellation token allocations
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/42652
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/42725

Add `IConnectionCompleteFeature` to QUIC stream abstraction and use it to get complete notification instead of `ConnectionClosed` cancellation token.

issue_context.title: HTTP/3: Try to avoid QuicStreamContext.ConnectionClosed cancellation token
issue_context.body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [X] I have searched the existing issues

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe the problem.

We're using the cancellation of `QuicStreamContext.ConnectionClosed` CT in `Http3Stream` as a notification that the QUIC stream is done.

This means:
1. ConnectionClosed CTS is always allocated
2. Allocate a CTS registration when subscribing to close event
3. ConnectionClosed must always be canceled when a stream is completed (and so can't be reused)

This creates various allocations:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/303201/178258703-eed0682a-ca16-48c2-b265-46c0acce9501.png)

### Describe the solution you'd like

`Http3Stream` never uses the CT with other async methods, just as an expensive event. Consider a lighter-weight way of providing a connection end event.

### Additional context

_No response_
